newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent to trade through Chinese New Year.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent to trade through Chinese New Year.

text.p: Trading of Brent crude oil futures on the Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) will continue through the Chinese New Year holidays, SIMEX officials said on Monday.
Friday February 7 and Monday February 10 have been declared national holidays in Singapore.
The Brent market will be open but it will close at 0800 GMT on February 6 and February 7, instead of the normal close of 0958 GMT.
